prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
blank_sentence: A study of three centuries of village records describes the glacier as the valley's ______.

worlds.passage: A glacier fills the head of a high valley whose river runs past farming villages to the plain. It can be seen only from the last village, where the road from the plain ends. Snow piles on it all winter, and the river runs fullest at the height of summer, when the plain's rain-fed streams dry up and the villages open their ditches. Its meltwater filters for days through gravel, so the river's level hardly changes between morning and night. Its front has held one rock ledge since the 1700s, through warm decades and cold. A study of three centuries of village records describes the glacier as the valley's ______.
worlds.explanation: Winter snow piles up on the glacier, and its river runs fullest at the height of summer, when the plain's rain-fed streams dry up and the villages open their ditches, so the glacier holds the winter's water and gives it out in summer: it is the valley's "storeroom." A "thermometer" registers changes in temperature, but the glacier's front has stayed at one ledge through warm decades and cold. A "timepiece" marks the passing hours, but meltwater filtering for days through gravel keeps the river's level nearly the same morning and night. A "signpost" points travelers along a route, but the glacier can be seen only from the last village, where the road ends, so no traveler can steer by it on the way.
